effect_description_eng: [On Play] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]) or the [Royal Knight] trait, this Digimon gets +2000 DP.
